-module(bmscl_route_eredis_client).

-export([
    start_command/1,
    start_subscription/1,
    subscribe/3,
    get/2,
    ack/1
]).

start_command(Options) ->
    eredis:start_link(Options).

start_subscription(Options) ->
    eredis_sub:start_link(Options).

subscribe(Pid, Channel, Owner) when is_pid(Pid), is_pid(Owner), is_binary(Channel) ->
    ok = eredis_sub:controlling_process(Pid, Owner),
    eredis_sub:subscribe(Pid, [Channel]).

get(Pid, Key) when is_pid(Pid), is_binary(Key) ->
    eredis:q(Pid, [<<"GET">>, Key]).

ack(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    eredis_sub:ack_message(Pid).

-module(bmscl_route_redis_source).
-behaviour(gen_server).
-behaviour(bmscl_route_source).

-export([start_link/0, subscribe/1, snapshot/0, status/0, decode_snapshot/1]).
-export([init/1, handle_call/3, handle_cast/2, handle_info/2, terminate/2, code_change/3]).

-record(state, {
    client_module = bmscl_route_eredis_client,
    command = undefined,
    subscription = undefined,
    subscriber = undefined,
    channel = <<"bmscl:routes:changed">>,
    snapshot_key = <<"bmscl:routes:snapshot">>,
    redis_options = [],
    config_error = undefined,
    connected = false,
    base_retry_ms = 500,
    retry_ms = 500,
    retry_max_ms = 30000,
    last_error = undefined,
    last_connected_ms = undefined
}).

start_link() ->
    gen_server:start_link({local, ?MODULE}, ?MODULE, [], []).

subscribe(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    gen_server:call(?MODULE, {subscribe, Pid}).

snapshot() ->
    gen_server:call(?MODULE, snapshot, infinity).

status() ->
    gen_server:call(?MODULE, status).

init([]) ->
    process_flag(trap_exit, true),
    State0 = load_config(),
    self() ! connect,
    {ok, State0}.

handle_call({subscribe, Pid}, _From, State) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    State1 = State#state{subscriber = Pid},
    case State1#state.connected of
        true -> Pid ! bmscl_routes_changed;
        false -> ok
    end,
    {reply, {ok, #{channel => State1#state.channel}}, State1};
handle_call(snapshot, _From, State = #state{config_error = Reason}) when Reason =/= undefined ->
    {reply, {error, {invalid_redis_route_source_config, Reason}}, State};
handle_call(snapshot, _From, State = #state{command = Command}) when is_pid(Command) ->
    Reply = fetch_snapshot(State),
    State1 = case Reply of
        {ok, _Meta, _Routes} -> State#state{last_error = undefined};
        {error, Reason} -> State#state{last_error = {snapshot, Reason}}
    end,
    {reply, Reply, State1};
handle_call(snapshot, _From, State) ->
    {reply, {error, redis_not_connected}, State#state{last_error = redis_not_connected}};
handle_call(status, _From, State) ->
    {reply, status_map(State), State};
handle_call(_Request, _From, State) ->
    {reply, {error, unsupported_call}, State}.

handle_cast(_Msg, State) ->
    {noreply, State}.

handle_info(connect, State0 = #state{config_error = Reason}) when Reason =/= undefined ->
    {noreply, State0};
handle_info(connect, State0) ->
    {noreply, connect(State0)};
handle_info({message, Channel, _Payload, Subscription},
            State = #state{subscription = Subscription, channel = Channel}) ->
    _ = safe_ack(State#state.client_module, Subscription),
    notify_changed(State#state.subscriber),
    {noreply, State};
handle_info({pmessage, _Pattern, _Channel, _Payload, Subscription},
            State = #state{subscription = Subscription}) ->
    _ = safe_ack(State#state.client_module, Subscription),
    notify_changed(State#state.subscriber),
    {noreply, State};
handle_info({dropped, _Count, Subscription}, State = #state{subscription = Subscription}) ->
    %% A dropped Pub/Sub message can only delay convergence. Force a complete
    %% authoritative snapshot refetch rather than trusting any notification body.
    notify_changed(State#state.subscriber),
    {noreply, State#state{last_error = pubsub_messages_dropped}};
handle_info({subscribed, Channel, Subscription},
            State = #state{subscription = Subscription, channel = Channel}) ->
    notify_changed(State#state.subscriber),
    {noreply, State#state{
        connected = true,
        last_error = undefined,
        last_connected_ms = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond)
    }};
handle_info({eredis_disconnected, Subscription}, State = #state{subscription = Subscription}) ->
    notify_disconnected(State#state.subscriber, redis_disconnected),
    {noreply, State#state{connected = false, last_error = redis_disconnected}};
handle_info({eredis_connected, Subscription}, State = #state{subscription = Subscription}) ->
    %% Reconnect is itself an invalidation event because messages may have been
    %% missed while disconnected.
    notify_changed(State#state.subscriber),
    {noreply, State#state{
        connected = true,
        last_error = undefined,
        last_connected_ms = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond)
    }};
handle_info({'EXIT', Pid, Reason}, State0) ->
    case client_role(Pid, State0) of
        none -> {noreply, State0};
        _Role ->
            %% Command and Pub/Sub clients form one logical Redis connection
            %% pair. If either half exits, tear down the surviving peer before
            %% forgetting its PID; otherwise reconnect cycles leak linked client
            %% processes that can never become authoritative again.
            State1 = stop_clients(State0#state{
                connected = false,
                last_error = {redis_client_exit, Reason}
            }),
            notify_disconnected(State1#state.subscriber, Reason),
            {noreply, schedule_reconnect(State1)}
    end;
handle_info(_Info, State) ->
    {noreply, State}.

terminate(_Reason, State) ->
    stop_clients(State),
    ok.

code_change(_OldVsn, State, _Extra) ->
    {ok, State}.

load_config() ->
    Config0 = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_redis, #{}),
    Client = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_redis_client_module,
                                 bmscl_route_eredis_client),
    Config = case is_map(Config0) of true -> Config0; false -> #{} end,
    BaseRetry = positive_integer(maps:get(retry_ms, Config, 500), 500),
    RetryMax0 = positive_integer(maps:get(retry_max_ms, Config, 30000), 30000),
    RetryMax = erlang:max(BaseRetry, RetryMax0),
    Channel = as_binary(maps:get(channel, Config, <<"bmscl:routes:changed">>)),
    SnapshotKey = as_binary(maps:get(snapshot_key, Config, <<"bmscl:routes:snapshot">>)),
    case redis_options(Config) of
        {ok, Options} ->
            #state{
                client_module = Client,
                channel = Channel,
                snapshot_key = SnapshotKey,
                redis_options = Options,
                base_retry_ms = BaseRetry,
                retry_ms = BaseRetry,
                retry_max_ms = RetryMax
            };
        {error, Reason} ->
            #state{
                client_module = Client,
                channel = Channel,
                snapshot_key = SnapshotKey,
                config_error = Reason,
                base_retry_ms = BaseRetry,
                retry_ms = BaseRetry,
                retry_max_ms = RetryMax,
                last_error = {config, Reason}
            }
    end.

redis_options(Config) ->
    Host0 = maps:get(host, Config, "127.0.0.1"),
    Host = case Host0 of
        Bin when is_binary(Bin) -> binary_to_list(Bin);
        Other -> Other
    end,
    Port = maps:get(port, Config, 6379),
    Database = maps:get(database, Config, 0),
    ConnectTimeout = positive_integer(maps:get(connect_timeout, Config, 5000), 5000),
    ReconnectSleep = positive_integer(maps:get(reconnect_sleep, Config, 100), 100),
    Base = [
        {host, Host},
        {port, Port},
        {database, Database},
        {connect_timeout, ConnectTimeout},
        {reconnect_sleep, ReconnectSleep}
    ],
    WithUser = add_secret_option(username, Config, Base),
    WithPassword = add_secret_option(password, Config, WithUser),
    case maps:get(tls, Config, false) of
        false -> {ok, WithPassword};
        TlsOptions when is_list(TlsOptions) -> {ok, [{tls, TlsOptions} | WithPassword]};
        true -> {error, tls_requires_explicit_options};
        _ -> {error, invalid_tls_configuration}
    end.

add_secret_option(Key, Config, Options) ->
    case maps:find(Key, Config) of
        error -> Options;
        {ok, undefined} -> Options;
        {ok, Value} -> [{Key, fun() -> Value end} | Options]
    end.

connect(State = #state{command = Command, subscription = Subscription})
  when is_pid(Command), is_pid(Subscription) ->
    State;
connect(State0) ->
    State1 = stop_clients(State0),
    Client = State1#state.client_module,
    Options = State1#state.redis_options,
    case safe_start(Client, start_command, Options) of
        {ok, Command} ->
            case safe_start(Client, start_subscription, Options) of
                {ok, Subscription} ->
                    case safe_subscribe(Client, Subscription, State1#state.channel) of
                        ok ->
                            State1#state{
                                command = Command,
                                subscription = Subscription,
                                connected = true,
                                retry_ms = State1#state.base_retry_ms,
                                last_error = undefined,
                                last_connected_ms = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond)
                            };
                        {error, Reason} ->
                            stop_pid(Command),
                            stop_pid(Subscription),
                            schedule_reconnect(State1#state{last_error = {subscribe, Reason}})
                    end;
                {error, Reason} ->
                    stop_pid(Command),
                    schedule_reconnect(State1#state{last_error = {subscription_connect, Reason}})
            end;
        {error, Reason} ->
            schedule_reconnect(State1#state{last_error = {command_connect, Reason}})
    end.

safe_start(Client, Function, Options) ->
    try apply(Client, Function, [Options]) of
        {ok, Pid} when is_pid(Pid) -> {ok, Pid};
        {error, Reason} -> {error, Reason};
        Other -> {error, {unexpected_start_result, Other}}
    catch
        Class:Reason -> {error, {Class, Reason}}
    end.

safe_subscribe(Client, Subscription, Channel) ->
    try Client:subscribe(Subscription, Channel, self()) of
        ok -> ok;
        {error, Reason} -> {error, Reason};
        Other -> {error, {unexpected_subscribe_result, Other}}
    catch
        Class:Reason -> {error, {Class, Reason}}
    end.

safe_ack(Client, Subscription) ->
    try Client:ack(Subscription) catch _:_ -> ok end.

schedule_reconnect(State = #state{retry_ms = Retry, retry_max_ms = Max}) ->
    erlang:send_after(Retry, self(), connect),
    State#state{retry_ms = erlang:min(Max, Retry * 2)}.

fetch_snapshot(State) ->
    Client = State#state.client_module,
    Command = State#state.command,
    Key = State#state.snapshot_key,
    try Client:get(Command, Key) of
        {ok, undefined} -> {error, route_snapshot_missing};
        {ok, <<>>} -> {error, route_snapshot_missing};
        {ok, Payload} when is_binary(Payload) -> decode_snapshot(Payload);
        {error, Reason} -> {error, Reason};
        Other -> {error, {unexpected_redis_get_result, Other}}
    catch
        Class:Reason -> {error, {Class, Reason}}
    end.

decode_snapshot(Payload) when is_binary(Payload) ->
    try jsx:decode(Payload, [return_maps]) of
        Document when is_map(Document) -> decode_document(Document, Payload);
        _ -> {error, invalid_route_snapshot_document}
    catch
        Class:Reason -> {error, {invalid_route_snapshot_json, Class, Reason}}
    end;
decode_snapshot(_) ->
    {error, invalid_route_snapshot_payload}.

decode_document(Document, Payload) ->
    Schema = maps:get(<<"schema">>, Document, undefined),
    Environment = maps:get(<<"environment">>, Document, undefined),
    Version = maps:get(<<"version">>, Document, undefined),
    Routes0 = maps:get(<<"routes">>, Document, undefined),
    case validate_identity(Schema, Environment, Version) of
        ok ->
            case decode_routes(Routes0) of
                {ok, Routes} ->
                    {ok, #{
                        version => Version,
                        schema => Schema,
                        environment => Environment,
                        snapshot_sha256 => sha256_hex(Payload)
                    }, Routes};
                Error -> Error
            end;
        Error -> Error
    end.

validate_identity(Schema, Environment, Version)
  when is_binary(Schema), byte_size(Schema) > 0,
       is_binary(Environment), byte_size(Environment) > 0,
       is_integer(Version), Version >= 0 ->
    ExpectedSchema = as_binary(application:get_env(
        bmscl_supervisor, route_schema, <<"bmscl.routes.v1">>)),
    ExpectedEnvironment0 = application:get_env(
        bmscl_supervisor, route_environment, undefined),
    ExpectedEnvironment = case ExpectedEnvironment0 of
        undefined -> undefined;
        Value -> as_binary(Value)
    end,
    case Schema =:= ExpectedSchema of
        false -> {error, {route_schema_mismatch, ExpectedSchema, Schema}};
        true when ExpectedEnvironment =:= undefined -> ok;
        true when Environment =:= ExpectedEnvironment -> ok;
        true -> {error, {route_environment_mismatch, ExpectedEnvironment, Environment}}
    end;
validate_identity(_Schema, _Environment, _Version) ->
    {error, invalid_route_snapshot_identity}.

decode_routes(Routes) when is_list(Routes) ->
    lists:foldl(fun decode_route/2, {ok, #{}}, Routes);
decode_routes(_) ->
    {error, invalid_routes_collection}.

decode_route(_Route, Error = {error, _}) -> Error;
decode_route(Route, {ok, Acc}) when is_map(Route) ->
    Method = maps:get(<<"method">>, Route, undefined),
    Path = maps:get(<<"path">>, Route, undefined),
    DeploymentId = maps:get(<<"deployment_id">>, Route, undefined),
    ActorPath = maps:get(<<"actor_path">>, Route, undefined),
    case is_binary(Method) andalso is_binary(Path) andalso
         is_binary(DeploymentId) andalso byte_size(DeploymentId) > 0 of
        false -> {error, invalid_route_record};
        true ->
            Key = {Method, Path},
            Target0 = #{deployment_id => DeploymentId},
            Target = case ActorPath of
                undefined -> Target0;
                Value when is_binary(Value), byte_size(Value) > 0 -> Target0#{actor_path => Value};
                _ -> invalid
            end,
            case Target of
                invalid -> {error, invalid_route_actor_path};
                _ ->
                    case maps:is_key(Key, Acc) of
                        true -> {error, {duplicate_route_record, Key}};
                        false -> {ok, maps:put(Key, Target, Acc)}
                    end
            end
    end;
decode_route(_Route, {ok, _Acc}) ->
    {error, invalid_route_record}.

sha256_hex(Bytes) ->
    Hash = crypto:hash(sha256, Bytes),
    iolist_to_binary([io_lib:format("~2.16.0b", [Byte]) || <<Byte>> <= Hash]).

status_map(State) ->
    #{
        connected => State#state.connected,
        command_connected => is_live_pid(State#state.command),
        pubsub_connected => is_live_pid(State#state.subscription) andalso State#state.connected,
        channel => State#state.channel,
        snapshot_key => State#state.snapshot_key,
        retry_ms => State#state.retry_ms,
        last_error => State#state.last_error,
        last_connected_ms => State#state.last_connected_ms
    }.

is_live_pid(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) -> is_process_alive(Pid);
is_live_pid(_) -> false.

notify_changed(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) -> Pid ! bmscl_routes_changed, ok;
notify_changed(_) -> ok.

notify_disconnected(Pid, Reason) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    Pid ! {bmscl_route_source_disconnected, Reason},
    ok;
notify_disconnected(_, _) -> ok.

client_role(Pid, #state{command = Pid}) when is_pid(Pid) -> command;
client_role(Pid, #state{subscription = Pid}) when is_pid(Pid) -> subscription;
client_role(_, _) -> none.

clear_clients(State) ->
    State#state{command = undefined, subscription = undefined}.

stop_clients(State) ->
    stop_pid(State#state.command),
    stop_pid(State#state.subscription),
    clear_clients(State).

stop_pid(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    catch unlink(Pid),
    catch exit(Pid, shutdown),
    ok;
stop_pid(_) -> ok.

positive_integer(Value, _Default) when is_integer(Value), Value > 0 -> Value;
positive_integer(_Value, Default) -> Default.

as_binary(Value) when is_binary(Value) -> Value;
as_binary(Value) when is_list(Value) -> unicode:characters_to_binary(Value);
as_binary(Value) when is_atom(Value) -> atom_to_binary(Value, utf8);
as_binary(Value) -> unicode:characters_to_binary(io_lib:format("~p", [Value])).
